prompt: We have an existing e-commerce platform that already has a problem statement and target audience defined in docs/design/. I want to work through the remaining design pipeline step by step with your guidance.

assertions.text: Determines access mode as Guided (step by step)
Determines project state as partially done or existing product
Checks for existing deliverables in docs/design/
Identifies which skills to skip based on existing work (ux-big-idea, ux-problem-statement, ux-target-audience)
Determines correct pipeline entry point (after target-audience, starting at ux-assumptions)
Presents each skill with explanation before invoking
Asks for user approval before each skill
Maintains interactive flow throughout (does not batch or auto-run)
